title: CFOs Confront the AI Value Gap: Investment Surges, Maturity Stalls, Cost Controls Lag
creator: Dr. Debasis Pahi
key_facts: HTEC FSI report 28 Oct 2026: 88% increased AI investment, 42% significantly vs 28% overall; maturity 44% same as market; 78% people/processes constrain more than tech
Deloitte Q3 2026 CFO Signals: ~80% finance formal role; 53% retrospective cost review; 56% basic controls; 20% advanced; 74% days/weeks to pause
philosophy: AI generates. Data informs. Finance measures. Accounting verifies. Human judgment decides.
